newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures close narrowly mixed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures close narrowly mixed.

text.p: Rubber futures closed narrowly mixed in moderate trade amid uncertainty over the near-term direction of the market, brokers said on Thursday.
They said prices in Tokyo and Kobe were also mixed after thin and range-bound trade as private investors were generally sidelined and looking for direction.

"The market was basically quiet in the morning with some inquiries for TSR20 rubber. But sentiment remained weak and RSS3 and RSS1 rubber was practically untraded. But prices turned mixed in the afternoon on narrow range trade amid uncertainty over market direction due to lack of fresh incentives, he said.
"It was just another dull day in the office today. Everybody was exhausted after yesterday's really heavy short covering," another rubber trader said.
At around 0945 GMT, February RSS3 fell one cent to 124.50 U.S. cents a kg.
March RSS1 was unchanged from Wednesday's settlement of 181.50 Singapore cents (US$1.29) a kg.
March TSR20 fell 0.75 cent to 174.00 Singapore cents (US$1.24) a kg.
